traceabilityChecks.summary: The 22-word ceiling is declared once at SENTENCE_MAX_WORDS = 22 and covered by a synthetic test that fails a 23-word sentence and passes a 22-word one.
This iteration reviewed routing and test surfaces, not a feature-catalog page.
The review target is a file list, not a spec folder, so there is no checklist.md.
The mode's SKILL.md keyword line and the hub router now agree on the readme intent; the disagreement that remains is in ROUTER.md, which no check reads.
No playbook scenario covers the routing vocabulary or the stress diagnostics assertion.

noveltyJustification: Two new P2 findings against ten carried findings. Both are duplicated-source-of-truth defects on surfaces the follow-up commits touched, so they add a maintainability direction the earlier iterations did not open; the ratio stays low because the shipped-behavior defects were found in iterations 1 and 2.
